description: Unit tests for the CTLogVerifier class, including verification of Merkle tree proofs, consistency proofs, and SCT verification, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture for CTLogVerifier, setting up a verifier instance and utility functions.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierTestUsingGenerator
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for testing with generated Merkle trees of varying sizes.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierConsistencyProofTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for verifying correctness of consistency proofs.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierAuditProofTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for verifying correctness of audit proofs.

methods.name: CalculateNearestPowerOfTwo
methods.description: Calculates the power of two nearest to, but less than, the given number.

methods.name: GetEmptyTreeHash
methods.description: Returns the SHA-256 hash of an empty Merkle tree.

methods.name: VerifyAuditProof
methods.description: Verifies an audit proof for a leaf in a Merkle tree against the root hash.

methods.name: VerifyConsistencyProof
methods.description: Verifies a consistency proof between two Merkle tree snapshots.

methods.name: CheckVerifyAuditProof
methods.description: Checks that an audit proof verifies correctly and invalid proofs do not.

methods.name: CheckVerifyConsistencyProof
methods.description: Checks that a consistency proof verifies correctly and invalid proofs do not.
